sources.entry: Satellite Eyes - macOS app to automatically set your desktop wallpaper to the satellite view overhead.

summary.one_liner: Satellite Eyes is a macOS menu bar app that automatically sets your desktop wallpaper to a satellite or map view of your current location overhead.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the system tray next to the clock and periodically updates the desktop wallpaper to a satellite or map view overhead. The README describes it as a Swift project targeting macOS 13.0, built in Xcode from SatelliteEyes.xcodeproj, with dependencies resolved through SwiftPM. It credits contributors for the icon, an image effects pipeline, and Retina-compatible icons. The README does not detail the specific image source or configuration options beyond noting that per-Space settings and more map styles are wanted.
use_cases: automatically change desktop wallpaper on mac
how_to_run: Build and run the app (targets macOS 13.0)
Optionally set your own team and certificates locally without committing those changes
notable: Lives in the macOS system tray and updates the wallpaper automatically
Shows satellite or map view of the overhead location
Image effects pipeline credited to a contributor
caveats: Building from source requires Xcode; the README points to a download but the URL is missing
Per-Space configuration and more map styles are listed as wanted contributions, not current features
